fieldData.full-article-text:
If you’re an XRD token holder, you can stake them by delegating your stake to a validator node. This can be done easily through the Desktop Wallet, available for MacOS, Windows, and Linux.

Tokens must be staked prior to an epoch starting in order to earn reward during that epoch.

fieldData.name: How do I stake tokens?
